chapter: Kansas City, Omaha and Lloyd Hunter
title: Nat Towles's band: personnel
summary: Gus and Dance list members of Towles's band, including C.O. Price, Henry Coker, Buddy Tate, Preston Love, Sir Charles and bassist Tom Pratt.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That's about it. Well, I tell you what, what are we talking about then? We started talking about the personnel. For instance, we hadn't said that C.O. Price was playing alto in that band. That's correct, isn't it?
Because I have some of these down. Then Elmer Crumley was with the band.
Elmer was -- he was with -- he was in Lloyd Hunter's band.
Elmer was with Lloyd Hunter's band?
Yeah, I'm quite sure he was.
Oh. Coker was with Nat Towles, wasn't he?
Oh, I see. Oh, I didn't realize that. Was Elmer -- was he a funny guy then, too? Like he used to be when he was with --
Oh, yeah, a very jolly man.
You know, he put that derby on and turned around and (unintelligible) and all that. He was a funny guy, wasn't he?
C. O. Price, he was with Nat Towles' band.
Yeah, that's right. Well, let's talk about Nat Towles' band for a minute. Buddy Tate was in the band.
And Preston Love was in the band.
And you said that Johnny Otis came in
the band after a while. Did he replace that drummer?
No, he didn't. I take that back.
Johnny Otis came in Lloyd Hunter's band. After I left.
When I left Lloyd Hunter's band, I went to Ottumwa, Iowa.
Well, I went there to join Ernest Redd. Spec Redd, they called him. He was a piano player.
Oh, well, we'll get to that in a minute, because that's your next move and we want to get to that.
But let's just finish on the band that was battling you. I'll tell you who else. You said Sir Charles was with Nat Towles for awhile.
Was he playing piano that night?
He takes his music seriously, too.
Not that night, not the night we had the battle, no.
Well, then you said K.C. Casey Smith was playing guitar. Was he in that band? That battled you?
And you said he's got a trio now, in Chicago?
And he taught himself to play bass.
And he's still going on, has a nice little trio. (Unintelligible.) fancy that.
I know what we were talking about.
The bass player was Tom Pratt.
Now, you knew him at school.
I knew him in at school.
And his he the one that you said was just such a very good bass player, or was Basie the one you said was such a good --
No, he was a very good bass player. And Basie was, too. But --
What happened to Tom Pratt, then?
Well, he took sick and I think the fever affected his brain.
Yeah, that was too bad. But he worked --
So he was with Nat Towles for a long time.
